WEST SALEM, Ohio (WJW) - Did you spot it? Several FOX 8 viewers reported seeing a greenish fireball soaring across the sky on Wednesday evening.

One viewer said her 11-year-old son captured the video above of the fireball over West Salem.

It was also spotted over North Ridgeville, as seen in the following viewer video.

According to the American Meteor Society, a fireball is another name for a "very bright meteor, generally brighter than magnitude -4, which is about the same magnitude of the planet Venus in the morning or evening sky."

The American Meteor Society received six reports of a fireball around 7:40 p.m. Wednesday evening. Learn more right here.
